source_text: Tasha?

structure.raw_value: BrShOp.Tasha?
structure.script_literal: "BrShOp.Tasha?"

translation: Tasho?

source_text: Father, I brought Erica.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Father, I brought Erica.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Father, I brought Erica."

translation: Ojcze, przyprowadziłam Ericę.

source_text: Thank goodness. We’ve made no progress.

structure.raw_value: JuSaOp.Thank goodness. We’ve made no progress.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaOp.Thank goodness. We’ve made no progress."

translation: Całe szczęście. Niczego jeszcze nie ustaliliśmy.

source_text: I have no idea where your mother is.

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.I have no idea where your mother is.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.I have no idea where your mother is."

translation: Nie mam pojęcia, gdzie jest twoja matka.

source_text: Henry is gone… And now Diana… I don’t know what to do.

structure.raw_value: TaSaDe^.Henry is gone… And now Diana… I don’t know what to do.
structure.script_literal: "TaSaDe^.Henry is gone… And now Diana… I don’t know what to do."

translation: Henry zniknął… A teraz jeszcze Diana… Nie wiem, co robić.

source_text: Nellie is with the commissioner.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Nellie is with the commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Nellie is with the commissioner."

translation: Nellie jest z panią komisarz.

source_text: What the hell? She needs to tell me what’s going on.

structure.raw_value: TaAnDe^.What the hell? She needs to tell me what’s going on.
structure.script_literal: "TaAnDe^.What the hell? She needs to tell me what’s going on."

translation: Co jest, do cholery? Musi mi powiedzieć, co się dzieje.

source_text: Don’t count on your mother, Tasha. I learned that the hard way.

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx.Don’t count on your mother, Tasha. I learned that the hard way.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx.Don’t count on your mother, Tasha. I learned that the hard way."

translation: Nie licz na swoją matkę, Tasho. Przekonałem się o tym na własnej skórze.

source_text: Listen… I’m studying something… But you can stay.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Listen… I’m studying something… But you can stay.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Listen… I’m studying something… But you can stay."

translation: Słuchaj… Nad czymś pracuję… Ale możecie zostać.

source_text: Do you need help with the Casula language?

structure.raw_value: ErBaOp^.Do you need help with the Casula language?
structure.script_literal: "ErBaOp^.Do you need help with the Casula language?"

translation: Potrzebujesz pomocy z językiem Casula?

source_text: I do. There’s something going on that’s brought a demonic presence to North Santiva…

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.I do. There’s something going on that’s brought a demonic presence to North Santiva…
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.I do. There’s something going on that’s brought a demonic presence to North Santiva…"

translation: Tak. Coś sprowadziło demoniczną obecność do North Santiva…

source_text: I suspect it has something to do with the Toma Leolo.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.I suspect it has something to do with the Toma Leolo.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.I suspect it has something to do with the Toma Leolo."

translation: Podejrzewam, że ma to coś wspólnego z Tomą Leolo.

source_text: You know… I happen to have some experience with Casula rituals myself.

structure.raw_value: TaFlEx^.You know… I happen to have some experience with Casula rituals myself.
structure.script_literal: "TaFlEx^.You know… I happen to have some experience with Casula rituals myself."

translation: Wiesz… Mam pewne doświadczenie z rytuałami Casula.

source_text: Oh yeah… I’ve been in the depths of some crazy magic temples.

structure.raw_value: TaFlEx^.Oh yeah… I’ve been in the depths of some crazy magic temples.
structure.script_literal: "TaFlEx^.Oh yeah… I’ve been in the depths of some crazy magic temples."

translation: O tak… Bywałam w głębi naprawdę niesamowitych świątyń magii.

source_text: Perhaps you both can help us.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.Perhaps you both can help us.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.Perhaps you both can help us."

translation: Może oboje moglibyście nam pomóc.

source_text: I need to find Diana and Henry.

structure.raw_value: TaSaEx^.I need to find Diana and Henry.
structure.script_literal: "TaSaEx^.I need to find Diana and Henry."

translation: Muszę znaleźć Dianę i Henry’ego.

source_text: Duncan is looking for an amulet… by order of Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Duncan is looking for an amulet… by order of Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Duncan is looking for an amulet… by order of Madalyn."

translation: Duncan szuka amuletu… na rozkaz Madalyn.

source_text: If we can find Madalyn, we can find Duncan.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.If we can find Madalyn, we can find Duncan.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.If we can find Madalyn, we can find Duncan."

translation: Jeśli znajdziemy Madalyn, znajdziemy też Duncana.

source_text: You're not just dealing with Earthly criminals. You’re dealing with demonic magic.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.You're not just dealing with Earthly criminals. You’re dealing with demonic magic.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.You're not just dealing with Earthly criminals. You’re dealing with demonic magic."

translation: To nie są zwykli przestępcy. Macie do czynienia z demoniczną magią.

source_text: I told ya! I’m bored and I want to go home!

structure.raw_value: HnAnEx^.I told ya! I’m bored and I want to go home!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnEx^.I told ya! I’m bored and I want to go home!"

translation: A nie mówiłam? Nudzę się i chcę do domu!

source_text: No one’s forcing you to be here.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.No one’s forcing you to be here.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.No one’s forcing you to be here."

translation: Nikt cię nie zmusza, żebyś tu była.

source_text: But I also want to have fun with the gang!

structure.raw_value: HnSaOp^.But I also want to have fun with the gang!
structure.script_literal: "HnSaOp^.But I also want to have fun with the gang!"

translation: Ale chcę też pobawić się z ekipą!

source_text: Oh! Hello, Erica.

structure.raw_value: HeHaOp.Oh! Hello, Erica.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOp.Oh! Hello, Erica."

translation: Och! Cześć, Erico.

source_text: Nice to see you again, Miss Heather.

structure.raw_value: ErHaOp^.Nice to see you again, Miss Heather.
structure.script_literal: "ErHaOp^.Nice to see you again, Miss Heather."

translation: Miło panią znów widzieć, panno Heather.

source_text: Seems like your wish is coming true, Hannah. More people for you to annoy.

structure.raw_value: ChFlEx>.Seems like your wish is coming true, Hannah. More people for you to annoy.
structure.script_literal: "ChFlEx>.Seems like your wish is coming true, Hannah. More people for you to annoy."

translation: Wygląda na to, że twoje życzenie się spełnia, Hannah. Będzie więcej osób do zamęczania.

source_text: We better get back to our studies.

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.We better get back to our studies.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.We better get back to our studies."

translation: Lepiej wracajmy do nauki.

source_text: Are you all staying?

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Are you all staying?
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Are you all staying?"

translation: Zostajecie wszyscy?

source_text: Uh, probably not.

structure.raw_value: HeHaCl.Uh, probably not.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaCl.Uh, probably not."

translation: Eee, raczej nie.

source_text: I’ll stay with you, Sister.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp>.I’ll stay with you, Sister.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp>.I’ll stay with you, Sister."

translation: Zostanę z tobą, siostro.

source_text: Will you join us?

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.Will you join us?
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.Will you join us?"

translation: Dołączysz do nas?

source_text: Sure. I can try and help.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp>.Sure. I can try and help.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp>.Sure. I can try and help."

translation: Jasne. Spróbuję pomóc.

source_text: Let’s go to the library.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Let’s go to the library.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Let’s go to the library."

translation: Chodźmy do biblioteki.

source_text: Come on, Ella. You can come with me to the farm. We can play with my new pet goat!

structure.raw_value: HnHaEx^.Come on, Ella. You can come with me to the farm. We can play with my new pet goat!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaEx^.Come on, Ella. You can come with me to the farm. We can play with my new pet goat!"

translation: Chodź, Ello. Pojedziesz ze mną na farmę. Pobawimy się z moją nową kózką!

source_text: Well, uh…

structure.raw_value: ElWoCl.Well, uh…
structure.script_literal: "ElWoCl.Well, uh…"

translation: No cóż…

source_text: I mean… Perhaps…

structure.raw_value: ElHaCl.I mean… Perhaps…
structure.script_literal: "ElHaCl.I mean… Perhaps…"

translation: To znaczy… Może…

source_text: I’ll stop by in a bit.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll stop by in a bit.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll stop by in a bit."

translation: Wpadnę później.

source_text: I guess a farm is as safe a place as any.

structure.raw_value: ElFrOp.I guess a farm is as safe a place as any.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrOp.I guess a farm is as safe a place as any."

translation: Chyba farma jest równie bezpieczna jak każde inne miejsce.

source_text: Don’t worry. I think you can handle Hannah.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Don’t worry. I think you can handle Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Don’t worry. I think you can handle Hannah."

translation: Nie martw się. Myślę, że dasz sobie radę z Hannah.

source_text: Heather… The case I was working on… We finished it today.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Heather… The case I was working on… We finished it today.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Heather… The case I was working on… We finished it today."

translation: Heather… Śledztwo, nad którym pracowałam… Dziś je zakończyliśmy.

source_text: That’s great news, sweety.

structure.raw_value: HeHaOp.That’s great news, sweety.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOp.That’s great news, sweety."

translation: To wspaniała wiadomość, kochanie.

source_text: There’s just one small hiccup.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.There’s just one small hiccup.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.There’s just one small hiccup."

translation: Jest tylko jeden drobny problem.

source_text: I might not get my job back as a detective.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.I might not get my job back as a detective.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.I might not get my job back as a detective."

translation: Mogę nie odzyskać pracy detektywki.

source_text: Get your job back? What do you mean?

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.Get your job back? What do you mean?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl.Get your job back? What do you mean?"

translation: Odzyskać pracę? Co masz na myśli?

source_text: It’s silly… But that redhead…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It’s silly… But that redhead…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It’s silly… But that redhead…"

translation: To głupie… Ale ta ruda…

source_text: Tasha?

structure.raw_value: HeBaOp.Tasha?
structure.script_literal: "HeBaOp.Tasha?"

translation: Tasho?

source_text: Yeah… She recorded Ella and me having sex for the world to see.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.Yeah… She recorded Ella and me having sex for the world to see.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.Yeah… She recorded Ella and me having sex for the world to see."

translation: Tak… Nagrała, jak Ella i ja uprawiamy seks, i pokazała to całemu światu.

source_text: They fired you for that!?

structure.raw_value: HeShOp.They fired you for that!?
structure.script_literal: "HeShOp.They fired you for that!?"

translation: Zwolnili cię za to!?

source_text: Sort of… Things are complicated, Heather.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Sort of… Things are complicated, Heather.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Sort of… Things are complicated, Heather."

translation: Poniekąd… To skomplikowane, Heather.

source_text: You’re good at figuring things out.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.You’re good at figuring things out.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.You’re good at figuring things out."

translation: Dobrze sobie radzisz z rozwiązywaniem problemów.

source_text: I suppose you’re right.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I suppose you’re right.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I suppose you’re right."

translation: Chyba masz rację.

source_text: Do the right thing and everything will work out.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.Do the right thing and everything will work out.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.Do the right thing and everything will work out."

translation: Postępuj właściwie, a wszystko się ułoży.

source_text: If you ever need my help, let me know.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.If you ever need my help, let me know.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.If you ever need my help, let me know."

translation: Jeśli kiedykolwiek będziesz potrzebowała mojej pomocy, daj znać.

source_text: It seems Chloe will be busy tonight with Judy. I should head home and clean up a bit.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.It seems Chloe will be busy tonight with Judy. I should head home and clean up a bit.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.It seems Chloe will be busy tonight with Judy. I should head home and clean up a bit."

translation: Wygląda na to, że Chloe spędzi dziś wieczór z Judy. Lepiej wrócę do domu i trochę się ogarnę.

source_text: See ya around, Heather.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.See ya around, Heather.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.See ya around, Heather."

translation: Do zobaczenia, Heather.
